projects.project_impact:
Developed a cohesive retail communication system that translated a key product benefit into consistent visual expressions across packaging and point-of-sale applications.

The project reinforced the importance of establishing communication hierarchy early in the creative process, particularly when extending a single product proposition across multiple retail environments.

A key takeaway was that effective retail design requires more than visual appeal; it demands a strategic balance between brand recognition, message clarity, and shopper attention at the point of purchase.
projects.impact_summary: Unified No Added Sugar communication across packaging and retail touchpoints.
projects.strategic_context:
#### The Business Challenge

In a competitive beverage category, communicating a product benefit requires more than adding a claim to the packaging. Diamond Juice needed to make its "No Added Sugar" proposition immediately recognizable while preserving the brand's established freshness cues and product appeal.

The challenge was to connect this message across packaging and retail environments without creating visual inconsistency or overwhelming shoppers with competing information.

#### Strategic Approach

The creative strategy was built around a benefit-led communication hierarchy: establish product recognition, highlight the primary product benefit, and reinforce freshness through supporting visual cues.

This framework guided the development of a unified visual language that could be adapted across different retail formats while maintaining consistent brand expression.

#### Creative Leadership & Execution

The creative direction focused on translating the strategic framework into practical retail applications, from on-pack claim treatments to shelf wobblers, gondola branding, and promotional displays.

Key decisions included strengthening the visibility of the "No Added Sugar" claim, maintaining recognizable Diamond Juice branding, and balancing nutritional messaging with engaging fruit imagery.

Each application was developed to function independently while remaining visually connected to the broader communication system.

#### Business Relevance & Outcomes

The project delivered a cohesive visual communication framework across multiple retail touchpoints, providing a consistent approach to product-benefit messaging and brand presentation.

By connecting packaging communication with point-of-sale execution, the design system supported clearer shopper-facing communication, stronger visual consistency, and a more recognizable retail presence.

#### Leadership Takeaway

This project reinforced the importance of approaching retail design as a strategic communication system rather than a collection of individual creative assets.

Effective creative leadership requires balancing brand objectives, consumer understanding, visual consistency, and practical retail requirements to develop solutions that are both creatively compelling and commercially relevant.
projects.scope: Packaging Claims · Retail POSM · Shelf Displays · In-Store Branding
projects.key_decisions:
**Benefit-First Communication** — Elevated the "No Added Sugar" claim as the primary communication message to support immediate shopper recognition.

**Structured Visual Hierarchy** — Prioritized product identification, nutritional benefit, and freshness cues to establish clear communication priorities.

**Consistent Visual Language** — Applied recognizable graphic elements, product imagery, and claim treatments across packaging and retail materials.

**Scalable Retail Application** — Adapted the visual direction to shelf wobblers, gondola displays, and in-store branding while maintaining consistency across different formats.

projects.impact_summary: SKU Expansion, Masterbrand Consistency & Product Differentiation
projects.strategic_context:
**Business Challenge**

Support the expansion of Diamond UHT Milk's flavored portfolio while maintaining brand recognition and clear differentiation across multiple SKUs.

**Strategic Direction**

Established a masterbrand-led packaging architecture that preserves Diamond Milk's core identity while allowing individual flavors to communicate distinct personalities and product propositions.

**Creative Leadership & Approach**

Defined three priorities: consistent brand hierarchy, distinctive flavor differentiation, and cross-channel adaptability. Extended the packaging identity into campaign key visuals and retail communication to establish a connected brand experience.
projects.desc:
Directed the creative development of Diamond UHT Milk's flavored packaging portfolio, establishing a unified brand system across Honey, Marshmallow, and Bubble Gum variants.

The strategy balanced masterbrand consistency with distinct flavor identities, creating a scalable packaging architecture designed to support SKU expansion, strengthen shelf recognition, and extend brand communication across digital and retail touchpoints.

projects.title: Diamond UHT Milk — Packaging Portfolio & Brand System Development
Diamond UHT Milk 200ml — Variant Packaging Extension
projects.desc: Diamond UHT Milk needed to expand its 200ml range with new flavour variants while maintaining a consistent, recognizable brand identity. The strategy balanced Diamond Milk's core identity with stronger flavour cues, colour differentiation, and character treatment — resulting in a range that became a Top 2 best-seller on shelves.

projects.title: Diamond UHT Milk Marshmallow — Packaging Design
projects.desc: Before Bubble Gum, there was Marshmallow. The challenge wasn't simply making the pack look playful or colourful — it was giving Marshmallow its own distinctive personality while ensuring it still felt unmistakably Diamond, through character design, colour, and a clear claim hierarchy for the 10 Vitamin 5 Mineral benefit. Designed to live beyond the pack, not just sit on the shelf.

projects.title: Diamond UHT Milk Bubble Gum — Packaging Design
projects.desc: Packaging is not only about making something look good — it needs to make the product easier to notice, understand, and remember. The challenge was finding the right balance between something playful enough for a younger audience while keeping the visual language clearly connected to the Diamond brand, built around a flexible system that lets Bubble Gum stand out on shelf without losing brand recognition.

projects.title: Diamond Milk Bubble Gum — Campaign Key Visual
projects.desc: Developed to strengthen awareness and visibility for Diamond UHT Milk Bubble Gum across digital and outdoor touchpoints, combining marketing and design objectives through bright colours, flavour cues, and dynamic product-focused visuals for stronger attention, appeal, and memorability.

projects.title: Internal Branding — Employee Engagement Merchandise
projects.desc: A shirt design built to support internal branding, employee engagement, and a stronger sense of belonging — a wearable brand asset using playful illustration, simple brand placement, and a positive message that turned internal merchandise into an everyday brand advocacy tool.

projects.title: Diamond Professional Mayonnaise 1KG — NPD Packaging
projects.desc: Developed the packaging design for a 1KG foodservice mayonnaise distributed through baking supply stores, supported by a key visual and in-store activation materials to strengthen product visibility and communicate its versatility for various food creations.

projects.title: Diamond Marley — Packaging Redesign
projects.desc: Packaging rejuvenation isn't always about making something look completely new — sometimes it's about understanding what should stay, and what needs to work better. The previous Marley packaging already had strong chocolate-category recognition, so the bigger opportunity was in the system: a clearer brand hierarchy between Diamond, Marley, and DARK/WHITE, stronger variant navigation through colour and typography, more appetising food visuals, and a new “Good For” section showing how each variant can be used — all while keeping what people already recognise.

projects.title: Master Milk Tomoro x Diamond — Barista Edition
projects.desc: An NPD packaging project for Master Milk Barista Edition, developed for the foodservice channel with Tomoro Coffee. I created a clear hierarchy with Master Milk Barista Edition as the main focus, balancing both Diamond and Tomoro brand identities in one uncrowded design.

projects.title: Sayang Liquid Berry Peony — Packaging Design
projects.desc: Developed Berry Peony as a new variant for Sayang Liquid Detergent, including packaging for the 300ml and 600ml sizes. Rather than treating the pack as a standalone decoration, the visual system was built around three priorities: brand recognition, sensory appeal, and clear benefit communication — introducing a more contemporary, expressive expression for Sayang while keeping it warm and familiar. Developed together with the Sayang Brand Team, including Brigitta Pricillia (Brand Manager) and Retno Puspa Wardhany (Graphic Design Supervisor).
